intent: Display one KPI with a label, value, and optional trend indicator.
useWhen: Showing a single metric such as revenue, users, or conversion rate
Composing a Scoreboard row of related KPIs
doNotUseWhen: Multiple metrics in one tile — use separate Scorecards inside Scoreboard
Charts, sparklines, or tables — out of scope for this contract

trendLabel.note: Accessible description of the trend, e.g. '+12% vs last week'

requirements: title is exposed as a heading
metric is readable as primary content
trend uses status colors and trendLabel when provided

doNot: Do not pack multiple KPIs into one Scorecard
Do not use raw hex colors in styles
Do not add buttons or links inside Scorecard
snippet: <Scorecard title="Active users" metric="12,480" trend="up" trendLabel="+8% vs last week" />
